unit.note: The canonical F0 runner was KeyboardInterrupted, so its 18 pytest roots were rerun separately on Python 3.11. The large shared root used four disjoint same-root shards; all roots passed with 47 skips, and the final manifest/root-lock regressions passed in the affected-root rerun.
